name: Kara Sevda
description: A young artist finds herself obligated to sacrifice her love story for hiding a family secret.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Nihan and Kemal, who live extremely distant lives from each other, unite in this miraculous love and become equals. When they make the oath of eternity to each other, both learn painfully that life does not allow such equivalence. Their lives, which changed overnight, lead Kemal to Zonguldak. Nihan in the arms of a choice she made. Years later, a mining accident will put two paths ahead of Kemal as a test. Will he continue to hide from everything he's run from over the years, or will he come back and reclaim what he's lost? When Kemal chooses one of these two paths, the distance between him and Nihan will close, the playing field will be leveled and the established balances will be shaken. Kemal's greatest test will begin the day he makes that choice. From that day forward, a choice is worth a love affair...

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Nihan’s memories resurface when she falls overboard again. While Kemal comes back to İstanbul to deal with some business, Emir runs out of patience and threatens Nihan. Emir gets his hopes high about Nihan after her encounter with Banu and he has a meeting with Kemal, who gives him a lecture. Meanwhile, Nihan is having second thoughts about her past with Kemal. Emir is excited about the contract and Kemal comes up with a plan to shock him. Someone unexpected shows up at Emir and Nihan’s anniversary party.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Nihan is still not over Kemal and feels uncomfortable with his presence in Istanbul. On the other hand, Emir wants to sleep with Nihan after five years, but Nihan still does not want him. Ozan finds out the truth behind the news about Emir and Banu and Tarık explains the real reason behind Kemal’s decision to stay in Istanbul. Kemal and his father have a heart-to-heart talk about Nihan and someone unexpected from Zonguldak surprises him. Meanwhile, Leyla comes up with a plan to make sure Nihan and Kemal meet.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Emir devises a plan to learn more about Kemal. Önder and Leyla are still not over their past and Salih is hesitant about telling Kemal everything about him and Zeynep. Leyla visits her mother’s grave and comes across someone unexpected. While Önder wants to meet with Kemal to talk about Nihan, Ozan is excited to meet Zeynep. Kemal has to go on a television program. Emir pays a visit to Kemal to put his plan into action. Önder and Vildan must make a decision about the video Emir showed them. Meanwhile, Tarık gets more and more jealous about his brother.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: While Tarık starts working for Emir out of jealousy towards Kemal, Önder decides to do something about Emir’s threats. Zeynep gets the good news from the casting agency. Kemal is surprised by what he saw in Emir’s office and his family is excited to meet Asu. On the other hand, Emir keeps threatening Önder about Ozan. Emir encourages Ozan about his new mysterious friend. Kemal argues with his brother about his new client and Fehime decides to pay a visit to Nihan over their fight. Zeynep encounters someone unexpected at her job interview.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While Kemal gets mad at his sister for lying and wants her to explain everything, Zeynep realizes that her phone is missing. Kemal pays a visit to the cast agency and learns something important about Emir’s plans. Müşfik is worried about Zeynep and wants Kemal to have a talk with her. Leyla suspects that someone is following Kemal, who fires Nihan in front of everyone. The police calls Vildan and tells her something that drives her crazy. Emir gives Ozan some advice about Zeynep and everyone gets mad at Zeynep because of the mail that arrived from the agency. Kemal officially declares war against Emir for what he has done to his family.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Watching the happiness of Emir and Nihan from afar, Kemal's pain and revenge ambition are also striking. Now this game will be rewritten as a rule. Nihan does not want more controversy in his life.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Kemal falls into deep suspicion when Nihan visits her new home. This suspicion is related to Emir and Nihan's marriage. Nihan, on the other hand, wants to warn Kemal, believing that Emir will harm Kemal.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Kemal emerges from his night with Nihan with his suspicions about Emir and Nihan even more acute. Emir openly declares war on Kemal and attempts a big game for this cause.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In response to Kemal's big question about Nihan's marriage, Nihan has nowhere to run. Nihan's confession will be the beginning of new questions for Kemal.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: When Nihan learns of the dangerous events that happened to Kemal, she does her best to stop him. The trail that Kemal will reach by risking his life will be the key to the secret of "that night".

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Kemal decides to take a very risky path to free Nihan. One step before she learns all the facts about that night, her love for Nihan confronts her as her biggest test.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Kemal is almost certain that Emir was involved in his stabbing. Thinking that the accident that happened to Önder was his work, Kemal vows to make Emir pay for what he did.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Nihan tells Kemal all the facts that bind her to her marriage to Emir. Kemal gets vital information about "that night". This is information that can completely change Nihan's life.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Kemal gives Nihan a whole new hope. If there is no body, maybe there is no murderer. Thanks to Kemal, Nihan decides to follow that night after years.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Nihan and Kemal find a way to talk to Karen about that night. Karen's answers prove that Kemal and Nihan are on the right track. Emir has only one option to stop Kemal.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Kemal and Nihan face another impossibility in their love after their sister's marriage. As they prepare to fight on this front, they receive shocking news that will hinder all their plans.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Nihan and Kemal reach the final level in their long-running "that night" research. One step away from the truth, the darkness that awaits them will redraw the fate of the two black lovers.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Karen's death deeply affects Kemal and Nihan. Karen's husband taking responsibility for the murder is like an open declaration that Emir has a hand in this murder. Kemal is very close to untie the knot.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Nihan is kidnapped! When Emir and Kemal start to investigate who kidnapped Nihan and why, a surprise name appears in front of them. They compete with each other and against time to save Nihan.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Kemal's rescue of Nihan and their reunion feeds Emir's resentment and jealousy towards Kemal more than ever. The truth will not let the couple's happiness last long.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Learning that his brother is a murderer, Kemal makes the most important decision in his life. From that moment on, the great test of Kemal and his family begins. Each of them will give honesty, conscience and justice tests separately.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Emir is shaken by what he learned from Kemal and has to face his traumatic past. Kemal and Nihan's paths soon cross again. The secret that separates them becomes a knot that unites their days.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: After the images put in front of him, Emir wants to prevent Nihan from leaving, but Nihan is determined. The ropes between Kemal and Emir are also tense. Nihan and Kemal look forward to the day they will be together.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: While Nihan and Kemal are counting the dawn for the day they will reunite, Emir's capture of the entire recording of "that night" will upset all the balances, but the main thing is the magnitude of Nihan and Kemal's love.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Nihan's suicide attempt shocks both Kemal and Emir. Everyone rushes to the hospital. Kemal is angry. If Nihan clings to life, Kemal will direct the story of the two alone for the first time.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: While Kemal and Nihan are on their way to their new lives, Emir notices Nihan's absence and goes crazy. Nihan is happier than she has ever been in her life, but Kemal predicts that Emir will follow them.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: When Nihan confronts Emir, she realizes that her fears are not unfounded. Kemal, on the other hand, thinks of a more effective way than convincing Nihan. He takes action to end his eternal enmity with Emir.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Emir, who sees Kemal in his private area with a gun in his hand, has a difficult decision to make. One way or another, he has to accept Kemal's deadly proposal to settle the accounts.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Kemal is uncomfortable with Nihan being around and can no longer contain his anger towards her. While Emir continues his happy marriage game with Nihan, Kemal's questions about this marriage will be completely exhausted.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: When Nihan and Emir fall into the midst of great danger, Kemal will be around Nihan like a guardian angel. What will happen will reach unpredictable dimensions.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Emir's game also gets Kemal out of control. It will no longer stop for whatever reason. Feeling that Kemal is about to burn all the ships, Nihan pushes all the conditions to reach Kemal.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: The smoke screen over "that night", which has been covered for years, finally begins to part. Nihan is more angry than ever before Kemal, who throws the first stone. It is time to face everyone and everything.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: The break between Kemal and Nihan, which started with Nihan's return to Emir, turns into a big chasm with the last event they will experience. It's time for Kemal to scrape Nihan out of his life.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Nihan's fainting at Kemal's engagement casts great doubt on both of them. Or is Nihan pregnant? At the end of the day, the love of Nihan and Kemal will experience the most difficult test ever.
